query:
WITH stamped AS (
                UPDATE meetings SET deleted_at = $2 WHERE _id = $1 RETURNING _id
            )
            INSERT INTO meeting_changes (meeting_id, position, at, by)
            SELECT stamped._id,
                COALESCE((SELECT max(position) + 1 FROM meeting_changes WHERE meeting_id = $1), 0),
                $2, $3
            FROM stamped
